text: Skilled artisans, carpenters construct homes, buildings, and other structures using materials such as wood, stone, and metal. They use their expertise to craft functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces. A crucial skill carpenters possess is the art of carpentry. This involves planning, measuring, cutting, shaping, and finishing wood with precision. They also apply joints like screws and nails, and finish the wood with varnish to protect it from stains and environmental damage. After completing the desired appearance, carpenters may employ various techniques to enhance durability and appeal.
